'''CM Pink''' is a character who is mentioned in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
CM Pink is an author who, some time prior to [[1992]], had a book called ''[[Connect]]'' published.

==Character==
===Influence===
His name is a reference to professional wrestler {{WP|CM Punk}}.
